anchorCapture.note: Label position and the right boundary are measured. The write box's left edge is derived from the label's rendered width, so it is the one estimated number here and is what independent visual review confirms.

anchorBasis: Write boxes read from the rectangles the form itself draws, extracted from the page content stream by scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-rule-lines.mjs. The earlier v6 boxes were measured by rasterising the page and looking for long dark runs; an independent review found every baseline 1 to 3.4pt off its true rule, the 77pt Case No. rule missed entirely and replaced with a fabricated 213pt box, and the COUNTY venue rule omitted altogether. Each box below is the rule's own rectangle, inset 1.5pt from its start, with the baseline 2pt above the rule, and the right edge clipped to the rule end or the next vertical divider, whichever comes first.

anchors.label: COUNTY
anchors.note: The venue line in 'STATE OF WISCONSIN, CIRCUIT COURT, ______ COUNTY'. Omitted entirely from v6; a petition filed without a venue is not filed.

anchors.label: Case No
anchors.note: Its rule is 77.16pt and ends at x=432.07, with the caption box's vertical divider at x=464.26. v6 declared a 213pt box, so a long case number was drawn through the divider into the court-use cell beside it.

anchors.label: Signature
anchors.why: Present on purpose. If supplying an anchor for a signature line were enough to write on it, the protect rules would be decoration. The factory must refuse this one every run.

deliberatelyUnbound.label: Email Address
deliberatelyUnbound.why: The shared field-semantics module maps 'Email Address' to participant.street_address, which is wrong. Binding it would print the street address on the email line. Left unbound and recorded as a defect in the shared module rather than worked around here.

deliberatelyUnbound.label: Telephone Number
deliberatelyUnbound.why: Writable and correct in semantics, but no telephone fact is part of this form's approved participant set; left for the participant.

deliberatelyUnbound.label: Date
deliberatelyUnbound.why: Refused by semantics: no allowlisted fact matches. This is the participant's signing date and is not ours to guess.

deliberatelyUnbound.label: State Bar No. (if any)
deliberatelyUnbound.why: Refused by semantics as an attorney field.

refusalFallbacks.rule: A value that cannot be drawn legibly inside its measured rule is refused, never shrunk below the readable floor and never clipped. The participant is told what to do instead, because a refusal without a fallback is just a blank line they do not understand.

byAnchor.Defendant's Name: If the full legal name will not fit the caption rule at the readable floor, the packet leaves the line blank and instructs the participant to write their full legal name on the line by hand before filing. The form's own footer permits supplementing with additional material, so an unusually long name may also be continued on an attached sheet referenced from the line.
byAnchor.Address: If the street address will not fit the signature-block rule at the readable floor, the packet leaves the line blank and instructs the participant to write it by hand, abbreviating the unit or building designator rather than the street, so the mailing address stays deliverable.

refusalFallbacks.notAFallback: Shrinking below the readable floor, clipping at the rule end, or overflowing into the Email Address rule below. None of those is done.

independentReview.reviewer: separate read-only reviewer agent, not the builder
blockersFound: Case No. write box fabricated at 213pt against a real 77.16pt rule; the boundary case number crossed the caption box divider into the court-use cell.
COUNTY venue rule omitted from the map entirely, with no decision recorded either way.
Every rule-line coordinate 1 to 3.4pt off, because the measurement rasterised the page instead of reading the content stream.
independentReview.correctionsApplied: All three. Measurement replaced with content-stream rectangle extraction, Case No. clipped to its true rule and divider, COUNTY bound to matter.county.
stillOpen: The finalizer overwrites the court's /Creator and /Title and strips /Author, /Subject and /Keywords, while this form's source record carries a co-branding rule. Raised against the shared finalizer rather than worked around here.
Participant values are drawn in blue (0 0 0.55 rg) with no recorded rationale; whether Wisconsin circuit courts accept blue ink on a filed petition is not settled in this repository.
